create_defaults: create default cost weights and task parameters for the Barkour MJPC task
build_torso_targets: build torso targets including height, pitch, roll, position, velocity, heading, and turning speed
set_foot_stepping_parameters: set foot stepping gait parameters with frequency, air ratio, phase offset, and swing amplitudes
configure_foot_position: configure foot position with lift height, forward extension, and inward movement
set_walk_velocity: set torso walk velocity with forward, sideways, and turning speed targets
